description: Fetches album lists and ratings from Album of the Year (albumoftheyear.org) user list pages. Note: This site uses aggressive Cloudflare bot protection that may block automated access.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_list: Fetches a user's album list page; requires url parameter; 参数: url, wait_time; 必填: url
  - get_user: Fetches a user's profile page; requires url parameter; 参数: url, wait_time; 必填: url

url.description: Full URL to the album list or user profile page on albumoftheyear.org

wait_time.description: Maximum seconds to wait for Cloudflare challenge to complete (default 30)
